assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 ARY Digital HD 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：ARY Digital Network / ARY Group / ARY Technologies。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言（乌尔都语）。
  6. 主要内容类别（巴基斯坦电视／剧集）。
  7. 内容供应模式：广播电视机构的节目存档。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，ARY Digital HD 排名第 19 名，历史累计观看量约为 78B（780 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 ARY Digital HD 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
ARY Digital HD YouTube Channel — Comprehensive Dossier

(1) Channel ID & Canonical URL

  • Channel ID: UC4JCksJF76g_MdzPVBJoC3Q
  • Canonical channel URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4JCksJF76g_MdzPVBJoC3Q
  • Handle/short URL: https://www.youtube.com/@ARYDigitalasia
  • Verified via YouTube's own channel page, Social Blade, Communitrics, and Wikipedia's most-viewed channels list [1][2][3][4].

(2) Operator & Corporate Chain

  • Operator: ARY Digital Network (the network entity runs the channel).
  • Corporate chain: ARY Group (Dubai-based holding company, established 1970, founded by Haji Abdul Razzak Yaqoob and Salman Iqbal) → ARY Digital Network (subsidiary, founded 2000) → ARY Digital HD YouTube channel.
  • Key person: Salman Iqbal (CEO/President of ARY Digital Network; owner per Wikipedia's ARY Digital infobox).
  • ARY Digital Network LinkedIn confirms it is 'the subsidiary of the ARY Group' and describes its channels including ARY Digital (Asia-Middle East-UK/Europe-USA Entertainment), ARY News, ARY Musik, ARY QTV, ARY Zauq, HBO, Nick [5].
  • Note: Wikipedia's ARY Digital infobox lists 'Parent: Karachi Kings', while the ARY Digital Network page lists Karachi Kings as a subsidiary of the network; this appears to be an infobox inconsistency — the authoritative LinkedIn and Wikipedia article text both place ARY Digital Network under ARY Group [6][5].

(3) Channel Creation Date & Earliest Still-Public Upload

  • Channel created: July 11, 2016 (Social Blade explicitly states 'Created On: Jul 11, 2016'; vidiQ corroborates; Wikitubia notes the channel was created in the 2016–2017 wave of ARY channel registrations [2][7][8].)
  • Earliest still-public upload: 'Siskiyan Ep 01 | ARY Digital Drama' uploaded on July 11, 2016 (video page shows '49,987 views • Jul 11, 2016'; Wikitubia cites this video as the channel's first upload) [9][8].

(4) Operating Location & Displayed Country

  • Displayed country: Pakistan (Communitrics shows 🇵🇰 [Pakistan]; vidiQ states 'ARY Digital HD is based in Pakistan'; Wikipedia's list of most-viewed channels lists Country: Pakistan) [3][7][4].
  • Corporate headquarters: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan (ARY Digital); London, UK / Dubai, UAE / Karachi, Pakistan (ARY Digital Network). Broadcast area covers Pakistan, Middle East, North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific [6][10][5].

(5) Language

  • Primary language: Urdu (Wikipedia's list of most-viewed channels lists 'Primary language(s): Urdu'; content is overwhelmingly Urdu-language drama with English subtitles on many uploads) [4].

(6) Primary Content Category

  • Category: Entertainment (Wikipedia and Communitrics both classify as 'Entertainment'). More specifically, Pakistani television entertainment — dramas, sitcoms, talk shows, web series, reality shows, and culture content. Wikitubia describes it as 'focused towards on Pakistani entertainment dramas, sitcoms, talk shows, web series and culture' [4][3][8].
  • As of the Wikipedia list (c. 2026), ARY Digital HD ranks #19 globally among most-viewed channels with 75.1B views [4]. Communitrics (Sept 2026 snapshot) shows ~78B lifetime views, rank #53 globally but #2 in Pakistan [3].

(7) Content Supply Model: Broadcaster Archives

  • The channel operates as a broadcaster archive model: ARY Digital (the TV network) uploads full episodes of its dramas and other programming to YouTube as a free distribution channel. Biza Asia confirms: 'The broadcaster's official YouTube channel has previously carried full episodes and built a substantial international audience around its programming' [11].
  • The channel uploads daily (Social Blade reports 240K+ videos, with daily upload volumes of ~100–150 videos) [2].
  • Notable strategic shift: From September 17, 2026, ARY Digital began removing drama content from YouTube for viewers in Pakistan, redirecting them to its OTT platform ARY Plus. This confirms the YouTube channel historically served as the free public archive/distribution arm of the broadcaster [11].

(8) Representative Series
Top ARY Digital dramas ranked by average episode views on YouTube (source: entertainment.era Instagram ranking, methodology: average episode views excluding teasers/OSTs, from all channels): 1) Kaisi Teri Khudgarzi, 2) Mere Humsafar, 3) Kabhi Main Kabhi Tum, 4) Sher, 5) Meri Zindagi Hai Tu, 6) Mere Paas Tum Ho, 7) Ishqiya [12].
Other widely recognized ARY Digital hits available on the channel include Dunk (250M+ views milestone reported), Parlour, Tamasha (reality show), Dar-e-Nijaat, Mirza Ki Heer, and Bas Tera Saath Ho [11][3].
